source.note: Model rows keep the upstream free_type, tos, pool, hard_stop and trains_on_prompts facts unchanged. Provider fields default_on, billing_warning and free_type_override are Rhizome's. Rhizome's gate (catalog.rs) decides which rows route. Provider order is ADR-0182 decision 1: default-on providers in the listed order, then opt-in providers. Cerebras and GitHub Models are dropped.

providers.name: Groq
providers.evidence: Upstream: public-page console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (2026-09-02), 200K TPD per model, 429 on exceed, no payment method on the Free tier. llama-4-scout, qwen3-32b and llama-3.3-70b-versatile left the free tier.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.evidence: Upstream: console-verified 2026-09-02 by diegosouzapw, Free mode 1,000,000,000 tokens per month at the organization level. Public pages confirm only that the cap exists.

providers.name: LLM7
providers.evidence: Upstream rows only. No dated evidence comment on this block, so it inherits the 2026-06-17 research pass.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.evidence: Upstream registry #11226 and passthroughModels: one key multiplexes many upstream models, so a 404 for one model locks only that model. ADR-0182 admits only ':free' ids.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.evidence: Upstream registry #6773: one connection multiplexes several vendors, so a 404 locks only that model. Tool names are limited to 64 characters. Upstream docs/reference/FREE_TIERS.md at the pin: about 40 RPM, no published token cap, and 'the old one-time credit pool has been removed', so the rows' one-time-initial label is stale. ToS caution: prototyping, dev, research and evaluation only. freellmapi checklist: NIM needs parallel_tool_calls=false. GLM 5.3 is not on the upstream NVIDIA list and is not added here.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.evidence: Upstream registry: 10K Neurons/day free, about 150 LLM responses. #8717 dropped dead Workers AI ids (400/403/410). The URL needs the account id from the credential.
providers.billing_warning: A card on file with Cloudflare could be billed when Workers AI use passes the free 10K Neurons per day. Turn this on only if you accept that.
